name: homebridge-stadler-form-noah
description: Homebridge plugin that exposes the Stadler Form Noah / Noah Pro humidifier to Apple Home over the local Tuya LAN protocol.
author: Brian Kenwell

scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/build-stamp.json', JSON.stringify({version: require('./package.json').version, builtAt: new Date().toISOString()}))"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --import tsx test/
scripts.watch: npm run build && npm link && nodemon
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run build
